svg.title: Incident Response Process Flowchart — Phishing Incident
svg.desc: Flowchart showing the 6 SANS IR phases: Preparation, Identification, Containment, Eradication, Recovery, and Lessons Learned, with sub-steps and decision points for the CyArt phishing incident.
svg.text: SANS IR methodology · CyArt Red Teaming · Arsalan Rasool Rather

g.text: IR playbook · SIEM · trained SOC team
